issues.explanation: Entity.php has a syntax error: invites() lost its opening brace and queues() was inserted inside it leaving a stray block, so the file cannot parse.
Negative priority throws LogicException instead of the contract-required InvalidArgumentException.
nextCode only inspects the single latest row by id, so A001 then A-X returns A001 instead of the required A002; it must scan back for the last valid A<digits> code.
Ticket factory defines code as null then allocates in afterCreating with save(), which violates tickets.code NOT NULL on insert and triggers the write-once guard on code.
Task requires updating docs/business-rules.md and docs/database-schema.md but no docs changes appear in the diff.
No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite new models, action, nextCode edge cases and call authorization paths.
queues migration adds softDeletes() but Queue model does not use SoftDeletes, leaving a dead deleted_at column.
called_by_user_id uses cascadeOnDelete so deleting a user deletes called tickets; SetNull or Restrict would preserve audit history.
Unused imports left in IssueTicket, Ticket and QueueFactory reduce clarity.

conventions.evidence: Uses app/Actions/IssueTicket and #[Fillable] matching Entity sibling style, migrations have reversible down(); but docs/business-rules.md and database-schema.md not updated, no TDD tests, extra softDeletes column without trait.

readability.evidence: IssueTicket, Ticket::nextCode/call and migrations are clearly named except app/Models/Entity.php:38-46 is unparseable due to broken invites()/queues() bodies plus unused imports.

requirements.evidence: app/Models/Entity.php:38-46 syntax error; app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:32 throws LogicException not InvalidArgumentException; app/Models/Ticket.php:256-265 nextCode fails A001 then A-X case; TicketFactory null code + afterCreating save conflicts with NOT NULL and write-once guard; missing docs updates.

scope.evidence: Diff is mostly queues/tickets models, enums, action, factories and migrations for the task; only extra is softDeletes column and unused imports.

security.evidence: Ticket::call checks entity membership and throws AuthorizationException, IssueTicket locks queue row and validates priority; only gap is cascadeOnDelete on called_by_user_id risking ticket deletion.

simplicity.evidence: IssueTicket retry + lockForUpdate and nextCode padding are minimal and direct; deductions only for unused imports and unneeded softDeletes column.

tests.evidence: change.diff:1-467 contains no tests/ directory additions; factory edge cases A999/A1000, malformed codes, inactive-queue rejection and unauthorized call are untested.

review.summary: Adds queues/tickets persistence, enums, IssueTicket action and factories covering the main issuance path, but Entity.php does not parse and the contract is broken in three places: wrong exception for negative priority, nextCode mishandles malformed trailing codes, and the ticket factory cannot create coded tickets. Missing required docs updates and tests, so the change must be rejected until fixed.
